Visibility and Tracking

Browse Visibility and Tracking terms for logistics professionals.

Languages

ArabicDeutschEnglishEspanolFrancaisHindiBahasa IndonesiaItalianoJapanesePortuguesRusskiyThaiTurkceVietnameseZhongwen

การจับลายเซ็น

The electronic or manual recording of a recipient's signature at the point of delivery as proof of receipt in transport documentation.

View term

การติดตามการจัดส่ง

The process of monitoring the location, status, and movement of a shipment via transport documents and carrier tracking systems throughout the logistics chain.

View term

การบันทึกเหตุการณ์สำคัญ

The process of recording key events, handoffs, or status changes in the shipment lifecycle—such as pickup, departure, customs clearance, or delivery—as mandated by transport documents and tracking systems.

View term

การปฏิบัติตามเส้นทาง

The verified adherence of a shipment or vehicle to the pre-approved or contracted route as specified in transport documents, regulatory filings, or security protocols, documented for audit and claims.

View term

การมองเห็นคำสั่งซื้อ

The capability to view, monitor, and manage the real-time status and lifecycle of customer orders across the supply chain, using integrated logistics systems and transport documents.

View term

การมองเห็นสินค้า

The degree to which cargo location, status, and condition are transparently accessible throughout the transport chain, as reflected in transport documents, carrier systems, and integrated supply chain platforms.

View term

การยืนยันการจัดส่ง

Formal acknowledgment, either digital or physical, that goods have been delivered to and accepted by the consignee, as evidenced in official transport documentation.

View term

การส่งสัญญาณตำแหน่ง

A digital signal or update sent by GPS, IoT device, or carrier platform to indicate the real-time geographic coordinates of a shipment, vehicle, or container as logged in tracking systems.

View term

การเบี่ยงเบนเส้นทาง

A detected or recorded departure from the planned or contractually agreed transportation route, as monitored by GPS, carrier, or customs systems and documented in incident logs or regulatory reports.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนการมาถึง

A real-time notification sent to designated parties when a shipment, container, or vehicle has arrived at a specified location such as a port, terminal, or customer site, as logged in transport documents or tracking platforms.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนการออกเดินทาง

A real-time notification sent to stakeholders when a shipment, container, or vehicle departs from a designated origin point, such as a port, warehouse, or supplier facility, as logged in transport documents or tracking systems.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนข้อยกเว้น

A specific notification sent when a deviation, disruption, or abnormal event occurs in the shipment process, as documented by carriers, 3PLs, or transport documents.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนความชื้น

A real-time notification sent when humidity levels in a shipment, container, or storage environment exceed or drop below pre-set thresholds, as monitored by data loggers or IoT sensors and referenced in shipping documents for moisture-sensitive cargo.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนความล่าช้า

A real-time notification sent to stakeholders when a shipment or transport event is delayed beyond expected milestones, as logged in carrier, 3PL, or TMS platforms and referenced in transport documents.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนอุณหภูมิ

A real-time notification triggered when temperature readings for a shipment, container, or storage environment exceed or fall below pre-set thresholds, as logged by sensors and required by transport documents for sensitive cargo.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนเหตุการณ์

A real-time alert or message to stakeholders about a key occurrence in the movement or handling of a shipment, as captured by transport documents, tracking, or regulatory systems.

View term

การแจ้งเตือนแรงกระแทก

A real-time notification triggered when a shipment or container experiences impact or shock above pre-defined thresholds during transit, as monitored by data loggers or sensors and referenced in transport documents for sensitive or high-value cargo.

View term

ขอบเขตภูมิศาสตร์

A virtual perimeter defined by GPS coordinates used in logistics to trigger alerts, monitor asset movement, or enforce location-based controls when shipments, vehicles, or containers enter or exit a designated area, as referenced in fleet management and security protocols.

View term

ค่าการอ่านเซ็นเซอร์

The recorded measurement from a sensor device installed in or on cargo, vehicle, or container—such as temperature, humidity, shock, or position—transmitted for compliance and operational reporting in transport documentation.

View term

จำนวนจุดหยุด

The total number of scheduled or completed stops for a transport vehicle or shipment during its route, as recorded on waybills, transport management systems, or carrier reports.

View term

ตราประทับเวลา

A precise digital record of the exact date and time an event occurs within the logistics chain, as captured in transport documents, tracking platforms, and data loggers for audit, compliance, and claims management.

View term

ตัวติดตามซัพพลาย

A digital tool or module integrated into transport management or ERP systems that provides real-time tracking and status updates for goods and materials in transit or at various stages in the supply chain.

View term

ตัวติดตามฝูงรถ

A centralized digital platform or telematics device used by logistics providers to monitor, manage, and analyze the performance, status, and location of a fleet of vehicles in real time.

View term

ตัวติดตามสินทรัพย์

A device or software used to continuously track the real-time status, location, and condition of logistics assets such as containers, trailers, or handling equipment for operational oversight and security.

View term

บันทึกการรับมอบ

An official, time-stamped log or document recording every transfer of physical possession or control of a shipment, package, or asset along the supply chain, as required for security, liability, and regulatory compliance.

View term

บันทึกการเดินทาง

A formal log or electronic file documenting the details of a transport movement—such as route, vehicle, driver, stops, times, and cargo status—used for compliance, billing, and auditing.

View term

ประวัติการเคลื่อนไหว

The chronological log of all recorded events, status changes, and location updates for a shipment or transport unit, as compiled from transport documents and tracking systems for operational review and compliance.

View term

พอร์ทัลการติดตาม

A secure online interface provided by logistics service providers for shippers and consignees to access real-time shipment location, transport events, and document status.

View term

ระยะเวลาพักค้าง

The total time a shipment, container, or vehicle remains stationary at a facility such as a port, terminal, or warehouse between arrival and departure, as documented in transport or terminal records for efficiency and compliance tracking.

View term

รายงานตำแหน่ง

A formal or automated communication that specifies the exact geographic location of a shipment, vehicle, or vessel at a given point in time, as required in transport documents and tracking protocols.

View term

สถานะการจัดส่ง

The official state or progress of a shipment’s delivery, as updated in transport documents, carrier systems, and recipient notifications throughout the transport chain.

View term

อัปเดตสถานะ

A formal record or notification of the current stage or event in a shipment’s lifecycle, as recorded in transport documents, tracking systems, or by carriers/forwarders.

View term

เครื่องบันทึกข้อมูล

An electronic device embedded in shipments to automatically record and store data such as temperature, humidity, shock, and location during transport for compliance and claims documentation.

View term

เวลาการออกจริง

The recorded date and time when a shipment, vehicle, or vessel physically leaves a specified location, as certified on bills of lading, port logs, and carrier reports.

View term

เวลาการออกโดยประมาณ

The projected date and time a shipment, vehicle, or vessel is expected to depart from a specified location, stated on bills of lading, port documentation, and transport management systems.

View term

เวลาขนส่ง

The total elapsed time taken for a shipment to move from origin to final destination, excluding dwell time at intermediate facilities, as specified in transport documentation and KPIs for carrier performance.

View term

เวลาจริง

Immediate, live data exchange and update capability in logistics and transport, enabling stakeholders to access shipment or status information as events occur.

View term

เวลาถึงจริง

The documented date and time at which a shipment, vehicle, or vessel physically arrives at its specified location, as certified on transport documents and port or warehouse records.

View term

เวลาถึงโดยประมาณ

The projected date and time a shipment or vehicle is expected to arrive at a specified location, as calculated by carriers, port terminals, or TMS and stated in transport documentation.

View term

แดชบอร์ดความโปร่งใส

A digital platform displaying real-time shipment status, transport milestones, and exception alerts across multimodal supply chains, as integrated with carrier and 3PL tracking data.

View term
